segments.name: Research and Development
segments.description: A biopharmaceutical company that focuses all its efforts on research and development of novel diagnostics and no longer performs therapeutic services.
segments.evidence: The Company now focuses all of its efforts on R&D and therefore no longer performs any therapeutic services.

changes.text: In 2024, the VIE Mios Pharmaceuticals Limited was dissolved and the Company no longer maintains any ownership over it.
changes.evidence: however, Mios was dissolved in 31 October 2024 and therefore we no longer maintain any ownership over such entity.

changes.text: In 2024, the Company terminated the merger agreement with YOOV Group Holding Limited under which YOOV was to become a wholly owned subsidiary.
changes.evidence: on October 25, 2024, the parties to the Agreement and Plan of Merger entered into a termination agreement (the "Termination Agreement"), pursuant to which the parties agreed to terminate the Agreement and Plan of Merger on the date thereof
